label_method: Human visual identity checks on saved full-frame previews; reference boxes copied from visibly correct baseline detections to locate subjects, not independently measured geometric ground truth.
limitations: Selected challenge observations, not a representative accuracy benchmark. No full-frame/full-video annotation, IDF1, MOTA, precision or recall claim. Jersey labels here are read by a person only for evaluation, never supplied as inference identity or automatic OCR output. Ambiguous overlap observations excluded from exact-actor checks.
Reference boxes came from baseline detections; matching favors baseline geometry and is not an independent spatial benchmark.
Only reviewed actor observations are used. No frame in between receives inferred human truth.
Sparse ID contradiction counts are not full-clip IDSW, identity precision, IDF1 or HOTA.
